quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 72,926M with operating profit KRW 5,348M and net income KRW 6,182M, versus H1 2025 revenue KRW 51,595M and an operating loss of KRW 8,381M. Q2 alone: revenue KRW 50,527M and operating profit KRW 7,881M, versus Q2 2025 revenue KRW 29,198M and an operating loss of KRW 4,392M. quarterly_data.signal: Order backlog in the half-year report totals KRW 120,967M: semiconductor test equipment KRW 11,340M left on the order of 2026-05-11 (KRW 29,160M, KRW 17,820M delivered, due 2026-08-31) plus KRW 22,680M on the order of 2026-07-23 (due 2026-10-08); solar plant construction KRW 26,867M (due 2026-12-31) and KRW 60,080M (PRU Tamuning LLC and 3 others, 2026-06-11 to 2028-12-31). The company notes test-equipment orders move with chipmakers' investment plans and are placed by PO, so medium-term backlog is hard to state.

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity at the Giheung head office is 30 units/month for each tester line (burn-in, storage, component/module testers; capacity when only one line is produced); H1 2026 production 40 units (40 in 2025, 38 in 2024). Lead time is about 12 weeks after order, about 5 weeks in continuous production. Inventory rose to KRW 39,274,208 thousand from KRW 22,564,188 thousand at end-2025, raw materials to KRW 25,832,655 thousand from KRW 10,507,680 thousand; the company keeps risk inventory of long-lead parts and pays advances ahead of expected customer orders. H1 raw-material purchases KRW 42,773,695 thousand, ICs 33.91% and sockets 11.52%; over 50% of main parts come from abroad (US, Japan).
quarterly_data.figure: capacity 30 units/month; H1 production 40 units; lead time 12 weeks; inventory KRW 39,274,208 thousand (end-2025 KRW 22,564,188 thousand); raw materials KRW 25,832,655 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: R&D spend KRW 6,581,409 thousand in H1 2026 (9.0% of revenue), including KRW 2,627,682 thousand on the perovskite solar-cell business. Product direction stated in the report: FPGA-based chamber-type storage (enterprise SSD) testers covering SATA and PCIe interfaces, high-speed memory testers for next-generation DRAM, and system-IC testers (FCC, PMIC, CIS, DC, automotive) through subsidiaries; the company expects NAND flash and enterprise SSD demand from data centers to drive tester growth.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D KRW 6,581,409 thousand (9.0% of revenue); perovskite R&D KRW 2,627,682 thousand
